verdict.rationale: The open guidance names some prerequisites before filing. It recommends registering through the online Florida Business Tax Application, states that eFile and Pay login uses a User ID and Password, shows a return-entry path keyed on Reemployment Tax Number and FEIN/ITIN, and discloses that an electronic certification statement appears before RT-6 submission. A login publication is also referenced, but these are scattered fragments rather than one consolidated list of steps, and the registration application itself opens on a login shell with transactions behind an authenticated session. missing for 10: a single consolidated statement of all account/credential steps before starting, any disclosure of identity-proofing or verification requirements (e.g., ID checks, MFA, PIN mailing), clarity on which filing paths need an account versus only RT number and FEIN, independent or hands-on confirmation that no undisclosed walls appear mid-flow.
